title: Capability isolation
contract: Caller without read capability observes the same public output for either secret.
scope: Public input and secret in 0..2; no read capability; pairwise comparison of secret choices.
assumptions: Exactly the abstract finite model and input domain described in scope; no claim about LLMLang implementation or unbounded executions.

obligations.claim: Output is identical across paired executions differing only in secret, and equals public input.
